title: 0DTE SPX Options Strategy Guide
metaDescription: Explore a 0DTE SPX options strategy with defined-risk spread examples, settlement mechanics, gamma assumptions, execution costs, and position limits.
excerpt: Compare SPX, XSP and SPY, work through three defined-risk spreads, and separate gamma estimates from evidence of a trading edge.

author.name: Billy Ribeiro
author.bio: Billy Ribeiro is the founder of Revolution Trading Pros. This guide explains options mechanics using cited sources and hypothetical calculations.

faqItems.question: What does a gamma-flip level actually tell me?
faqItems.answer: It identifies a zero crossing in a particular gamma model under its positioning and volatility assumptions. It is not an observed inventory balance or a guaranteed support or resistance level.

faqItems.question: Does a 70% win rate prove an iron condor is profitable?
faqItems.answer: No. Payoff sizes, partial outcomes, exits and costs matter. In a binary model with a $300 win and $700 loss, 70% merely breaks even before costs. That model does not measure the real trade probability.

faqItems.question: Are SPX and SPY options settled the same way?
faqItems.answer: No. SPX index options are European-style and cash-settled. Standard SPY ETF options normally deliver shares and have American-style exercise. Check the exact expiration, settlement and broker deadlines.

faqItems.question: Has the pattern-day-trader framework changed in 2026?
faqItems.answer: FINRA Notice 26-10 adopts replacement intraday margin standards effective June 4, 2026, with a firm phase-in ending October 20, 2027. Ask your broker which framework and house requirements apply to your account.

faqItems.question: Does the ThinkScript study calculate dealer gamma exposure?
faqItems.answer: No. It plots the observed opening-range high, low and midpoint. It has no option-chain or signed-inventory inputs and has not been compiled or replayed in thinkorswim as part of this review.
